fields.fieldText:
FEEDBACK SELECTION


Sending feedback is one of the keys in improving the RingCentral Troubleshooting Tool.


You as a user, are empowered to submit and feedback that you see fit specially in scenarios when feedback are necessary. A good example of these scenarios are as follows:

  • Finding something that is not working in the troubleshooting tool
  • Having suggestions to improve the troubleshooting tool
  • Submitting a request to create a new troubleshooting guide for a certain topic

fields.fieldText:
FEEDBACK SELECTION


Sending feedback is one of the keys in improving the RingCentral Troubleshooting Tool.


You as a user, are empowered to submit and feedback that you see fit specially in scenarios when feedback are necessary. A good example of these scenarios are as follows:

  • Finding something that is not working in the troubleshooting tool
  • Having suggestions to improve the troubleshooting tool
  • Finding something wrong with any of the troubleshooting guides
  • The outcome experienced was not the same as described in the troubleshooting guide
  • The steps provided in the troubleshooting guide are incorrect or are no longer applicable
  • Submitting a request to create a new troubleshooting guide for a certain topic

fields.fieldText:
REPORTING A PROBLEM WITH THE TROUBLESHOOTING GUIDE


Sending a feedback about a problem with the troubleshooting guides is one of the keys in achieving its ultimate goal---to help and educate its users.


You as a user, are empowered to submit changes or report problems that you see fit specially in scenarios when corrections are utmost needed. A good example of these scenarios are as follows:

  • Finding something wrong in the troubleshooting guide
  • The outcome experienced was not as described in the troubleshooting guide
  • The steps provided in the troubleshooting guides are incorrect or are no longer applicable

Below are all the troubleshooting guides you have used in this case. Please select the troubleshooting guide you are having problems with.
